.fruit-wrap{max-width:900px;margin:30px auto;border-radius:28px;padding:26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.fruit-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:15px}.fruit-top b{font-family:"Space Grotesk"}.fruit-hud{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.fruit-stat{padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#ffffff08;border-radius:11px;font-size:11px}.fruit-arena{height:500px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #ffffff16;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 20%,#18215a,#070a19 65%);touch-action:manipulation}.fruit-arena:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(#ffffff20 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:28px 28px;opacity:.35}.fruit{position:absolute;width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:48px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 16px #0008);animation:fruitFloat 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;z-index:2;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.fruit:hover{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 20px #22d3ee99)}.fruit.pop{animation:fruitPop .28s forwards}.fruit-crash-info{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:12px 0}.fruit-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}.fruit-actions>*{flex:1}@keyframes fruitFloat{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(8deg) scale(1.06)}}@keyframes fruitPop{to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.8) rotate(25deg);opacity:0}}.fruit-burst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-size:20px;z-index:4;animation:burst .6s forwards}@keyframes burst{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(.4);opacity:0}}
.hindi-prompt{font-family:"Space Grotesk";font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,36px);line-height:1.35;margin:7px 0 10px;color:#f7f8ff}
.sentence-hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
.answer-slot{min-height:64px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:#ffffff03;margin-bottom:16px}
.answer-slot.placeholder{color:#5a6485;font-size:13px}
.word-chip{padding:11px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1c2050,#12163a);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.word-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#8b5cf655}
.word-chip.used{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}
.slot-chip{padding:11px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #22d3ee40;background:#22d3ee14;color:#e0f2fe;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}
.word-bank{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px}
.sentence-actions{display:flex;gap:10px}
.sentence-actions button{flex:1}

<body>
<div class="ambient ambient-a"></div><div class="ambient ambient-b"></div><div class="grid-bg"></div><div id="particles"></div>
<main class="shell">
<header class="site-header">
  <button class="brand" id="brandHome"><span class="brand-mark"><img class="brand-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Visionaries logo"></span><span><b>VISIONARIES</b><small>DREAM • INNOVATE • BUILD</small></span></button>
  <div class="header-actions"><button class="profile-pill" id="profileBtn">👤 <span id="profileName">Player</span></button><button class="icon-btn" id="muteBtn" title="Mute / Unmute sound">🔊</button><button class="icon-btn" id="historyBtn" title="Question history">◴</button></div>
</header>

<section id="home" class="screen">
  <div class="hero-card glass">
    <div class="hero-copy"><div class="eyebrow">TEAM VISIONARIES • WORD QUEST</div><h1>Word<br><span>Quest</span></h1><p class="hero-sub">Quiz questions + Sentence Building challenges.<br>10 levels — Very Easy to Boss Level.</p>
      <div class="hero-actions"><button class="primary big" id="start">🎮 Start Quest <span>→</span></button><button class="secondary big" id="fruitHome">🍓 Fruit Crash <span>→</span></button></div>
      <div class="hero-stats"><div><b>10</b><small>LEVELS</small></div><div><b>3</b><small>LIVES</small></div><div><b>20s</b><small>PER LEVEL</small></div><div><b>👑</b><small>BOSS LEVEL 10</small></div></div>
    </div><div class="hero-orb"><div class="orb-ring ring-1"></div><div class="orb-ring ring-2"></div><div class="orb-core"><img class="splash-logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Visionaries logo" style="width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:42px;margin:0"></div><span class="float-chip chip-1">⚡ XP</span><span class="float-chip chip-2">🔥 COMBO</span><span class="float-chip chip-3">🇮🇳→🇬🇧</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="section-heading"><span>01</span><div><h2>Your Quest Toolkit</h2><p>Built to make learning feel like a real game.</p></div></div>
  <div class="feature-grid"><article class="feature glass"><i>🌍</i><h3>Quiz + Sentence Mix</h3><p>General-knowledge quiz questions mixed with sentence-building word-ordering challenges, across 10 levels from Very Easy to Boss.</p></article><article class="feature glass"><i>🎵</i><h3>Sound & Animation</h3><p>Chimes, combo fanfares and confetti bursts make every correct answer feel great.</p></article><article class="feature glass"><i>🔥</i><h3>Combo System</h3><p>Build streaks and earn bonus XP for consecutive correct answers.</p></article><article class="feature glass"><i>❤️</i><h3>3 Lives</h3><p>Wrong answers matter. Protect your hearts and keep the quest alive.</p></article><article class="feature glass"><i>🏆</i><h3>XP & Levels</h3><p>Turn every correct answer into visible progression.</p></article><article class="feature glass"><i>⚡</i><h3>Mini Challenges</h3><p>Break the quiz rhythm with surprise skill-based tasks.</p></article></div>
  <div class="account-card glass"><div><span class="eyebrow">PLAYER PROFILE</span><h3 id="homeGreeting">Ready for your next quest?</h3><p id="homeHistory">No quests completed yet.</p></div><button class="secondary" id="profileHome">Set Player Name</button></div>

];
const LEVELS=[0,100,250,450,700,1000,1400];
let played=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kqPlayedIds')||'[]'),history=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kqHistory')||'[]'),player=localStorage.getItem('kqPlayer')||'Player';
let round=[],i=0,score=0,xp=0,totalXp=Number(localStorage.getItem('kqTotalXp')||0),correct=0,lives=3,combo=0,bestCombo=0,timer=20,timerId=null,answered=false,challengeRewarded=false,sessionCats=new Set(),streak=0;
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const screens=['home','game','task','end','gameover','fruit','history'];
function show(id){screens.forEach(s=>$(s).classList.toggle('hidden',s!==id));if(id!=='game'&&id!=='task')stopBgMusic();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})}
function save(){localStorage.setItem('kqPlayedIds',JSON.stringify([...new Set(played)]));localStorage.setItem('kqHistory',JSON.stringify(history.slice(0,100)));localStorage.setItem('kqPlayer',player);localStorage.setItem('kqTotalXp',String(totalXp))}
function levelFor(v){let l=1;LEVELS.forEach((need,n)=>{if(v>=need)l=n+1});return l}
function nextNeed(l){return LEVELS[l]??LEVELS[LEVELS.length-1]}
function stats(){ $('score').textContent=score;$('xp').textContent=xp;$('level').textContent=levelFor(totalXp);$('combo').textContent='x'+combo;$('hearts').textContent='❤️'.repeat(lives)+'🖤'.repeat(3-lives);let l=levelFor(totalXp),base=LEVELS[l-1]||0,next=LEVELS[l]||base+300;$('xpBar').style.width=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,(totalXp-base)/(next-base)*100))+'%';$('xpLabel').textContent=`${totalXp} / ${next} XP to Level ${l+1}`;}
function toast(msg){const t=$('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toast.t);toast.t=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),1800)}
function levelCheck(oldXp){let oldL=levelFor(oldXp),newL=levelFor(totalXp);if(newL>oldL){$('levelupText').textContent=`${player}, you reached Level ${newL}`;$('levelup').classList.remove('hidden');setTimeout(()=>$('levelup').classList.add('hidden'),1500);}}
function chooseRound(){let mcqPool=QUESTIONS.filter(q=>!played.includes(q.id)),sentPool=SENTENCE_QUESTIONS.filter(q=>!played.includes(q.id)),selected=[];for(const lvl of LEVEL_META){if(lvl.n%2===0){let cand=sentPool.filter(q=>q.level===lvl.n&&!selected.some(s=>s.id===q.id));if(!cand.length)cand=sentPool.filter(q=>!selected.some(s=>s.id===q.id));if(!cand.length)return null;let q=cand[Math.floor(Math.random()*cand.length)];selected.push({...q,type:'sentence',level:lvl.n,levelLabel:lvl.label})}else{let cand=mcqPool.filter(q=>q.difficulty===lvl.diff&&!selected.some(s=>s.id===q.id));if(!cand.length)cand=mcqPool.filter(q=>!selected.some(s=>s.id===q.id));if(!cand.length)return null;let q=cand[Math.floor(Math.random()*cand.length)];selected.push({...q,type:'mcq',level:lvl.n,levelLabel:lvl.label})}}return selected.length===10?selected:null}
function start(){let r=chooseRound();if(!r){played=[];save();r=chooseRound();if(!r){showExhausted();return}toast('🔄 Question bank recycled — fresh shuffle!')}round=r;i=0;score=0;xp=0;correct=0;lives=3;combo=0;bestCombo=0;streak=0;challengeRewarded=false;sessionCats=new Set();stats();show('game');loadQuestion();startBgMusic()}
function showExhausted(){show('end');$('endTitle').textContent='Quest Bank Complete!';$('endSummary').textContent='🎉 You have completed all available questions. No question was repeated.';$('fs').textContent='—';$('fx').textContent='—';$('fl').textContent=levelFor(totalXp);$('fa').textContent='—';$('fc').textContent='—';$('fb').textContent='—';$('flives').textContent=lives;$('fquestions').textContent=played.length;$('badge').textContent='🌟 Quest Explorer';$('categories').innerHTML='All available questions completed.'}
function loadQuestion(){clearInterval(timerId);answered=false;timer=20;$('timer').textContent=20;$('timer').classList.remove('warning');let q=round[i];sessionCats.add(q.category);$('progress').textContent=`LEVEL ${i+1} / 10`;$('questionNumber').textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');$('bar').style.width=((i)/10*100)+'%';$('cat').textContent=q.category.toUpperCase();$('difficultyText').textContent=`LEVEL ${q.level} · ${q.levelLabel.toUpperCase()}`;$('adaptiveNote').textContent=q.level===10?'👑 Boss Level!':streak>=3?'🔥 You\'re on fire!':streak<=-2?'💡 Take it slow.':'🎯 Adaptive challenge';$('feedback').classList.add('hidden');if(q.type==='sentence'){$('q').innerHTML=`<span class="hindi-prompt">${q.hindi}</span>`;renderSentenceQuestion(q)}else{$('q').textContent=q.q;renderMcqOptions(q)}stats();if(q.level===10)sfxBoss();timerId=setInterval(()=>{timer--;$('timer').textContent=timer;if(timer<=5)$('timer').classList.add('warning');if(timer<=0){clearInterval(timerId);if(q.type==='sentence')sentenceTimeout();else answer(-1,null)}},1000)}
function renderMcqOptions(q){$('opts').className='options';$('opts').innerHTML='';q.o.forEach((o,n)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='option';b.innerHTML=`<span class="letter">${String.fromCharCode(65+n)}</span><span>${o}</span>`;b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();answer(n,b)};$('opts').appendChild(b)})}
function renderSentenceQuestion(q){$('opts').className='options sentence-mode';$('opts').innerHTML='';const hint=document.createElement('div');hint.className='sentence-hint';hint.textContent='Tap the English words below in the correct order to translate the sentence above.';const slot=document.createElement('div');slot.className='answer-slot placeholder';const bank=document.createElement('div');bank.className='word-bank';const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='sentence-actions';const clearBtn=document.createElement('button');clearBtn.className='secondary';clearBtn.textContent='↺ Clear';actions.appendChild(clearBtn);let picked=[],chipEls=[];function renderSlot(){if(!picked.length){slot.className='answer-slot placeholder';slot.textContent='Tap words below to build your sentence…';return}slot.className='answer-slot';slot.innerHTML='';picked.forEach((p,pIdx)=>{const c=document.createElement('button');c.className='slot-chip';c.textContent=p.w;c.onclick=()=>{if(answered)return;picked.splice(pIdx,1);chipEls[p.idx].classList.remove('used');renderSlot()};slot.appendChild(c)})}const shuffled=q.words.map((w,idx)=>({w,idx})).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);shuffled.forEach(({w,idx})=>{const c=document.createElement('button');c.className='word-chip';c.textContent=w;c.onclick=()=>{if(answered||c.classList.contains('used'))return;sfxClick();picked.push({w,idx});c.classList.add('used');renderSlot();if(picked.length===q.words.length)checkSentence(q,picked.map(p=>p.w))};chipEls[idx]=c;bank.appendChild(c)});clearBtn.onclick=()=>{if(answered)return;sfxClick();picked.forEach(p=>chipEls[p.idx].classList.remove('used'));picked=[];renderSlot()};renderSlot();$('opts').append(hint,slot,bank,actions)}
function checkSentence(q,orderedWords){if(answered)return;answered=true;clearInterval(timerId);played.push(q.id);save();[...document.querySelectorAll('.word-chip')].forEach(c=>c.disabled=true);finalizeAnswer(orderedWords.join('|')===q.words.join('|'),q.e,false)}
function sentenceTimeout(){if(answered)return;answered=true;const q=round[i];played.push(q.id);save();[...document.querySelectorAll('.word-chip')].forEach(c=>c.disabled=true);finalizeAnswer(false,q.e,true)}
function finalizeAnswer(isCorrect,explanation,timedOut){let oldXp=totalXp;const card=document.querySelector('.question-card');if(isCorrect){correct++;streak=Math.max(1,streak+1);combo=Math.min(4,combo+1);bestCombo=Math.max(bestCombo,combo);let bonus=combo>1?(combo-1)*5:0;score+=10+bonus;xp+=15+bonus;totalXp+=15+bonus;levelCheck(oldXp);save();$('feedback').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Correct!</b> ${explanation}${bonus?` <strong>+${bonus} BONUS XP</strong>`:''}`;if(combo>1)toast(`🔥 COMBO x${combo}! +${bonus} bonus XP`);sfxCorrect();confettiBurst(round[i].level===10?60:18);card.classList.remove('wrong-shake');card.classList.add('correct-glow');setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('correct-glow'),650)}else{streak=Math.min(-1,streak-1);combo=0;lives--;$('feedback').innerHTML=`<b>❌ ${timedOut?'Time\'s up!':'Not quite.'}</b> ${explanation}`;toast('-1 Life ❤️');stats();sfxWrong();card.classList.remove('correct-glow');card.classList.add('wrong-shake');setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('wrong-shake'),450)}$('feedback').classList.remove('hidden');stats();setTimeout(()=>{if(lives<=0){finishGameOver();return}next()},1050)}
function answer(n,b){if(answered)return;answered=true;clearInterval(timerId);const q=round[i];played.push(q.id);save();[...$('opts').children].forEach((e,j)=>{if(e.classList.contains('option')){e.disabled=true;if(j===q.a)e.classList.add('correct')}});if(b&&n!==q.a)b.classList.add('wrong');finalizeAnswer(n===q.a,q.e,n===-1)}
function next(){i++;if(i===5){openChallenge();return}if(i>=10){finish();return}loadQuestion()}
function openChallenge(){show('task');challengeRewarded=false;const types=['memory','pattern','math','word','prompt'];renderChallenge(types[Math.floor(Math.random()*types.length)])}
function rewardChallenge(scoreAdd=20,xpAdd=30){if(challengeRewarded)return;challengeRewarded=true;let oldXp=totalXp;score+=scoreAdd;xp+=xpAdd;totalXp+=xpAdd;levelCheck(oldXp);save();stats();sfxLevelup();confettiBurst(24);toast(`✨ Challenge complete! +${xpAdd} XP`);setTimeout(()=>{show('game');loadQuestion()},650)}
function renderChallenge(type){const icon=$('challengeIcon'),title=$('challengeTitle'),prompt=$('challengePrompt'),area=$('challengeArea');area.innerHTML='';if(type==='memory'){icon.textContent='🧠';title.textContent='Memory Sprint';prompt.innerHTML='Click the words in this order: <b>DREAM → INNOVATE → BUILD</b>';let arr=['DREAM','INNOVATE','BUILD'].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5),picked=[];const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='mini-grid';arr.forEach(w=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='mini-choice';b.textContent=w;b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();picked.push(w);b.classList.add('selected');b.disabled=true;if(picked.length===3){if(picked.join(',')==='DREAM,INNOVATE,BUILD')rewardChallenge();else{toast('Try again!');setTimeout(()=>{picked=[];[...g.children].forEach(x=>{x.disabled=false;x.classList.remove('selected')})},500)}}};g.appendChild(b)});area.appendChild(g)}else if(type==='pattern'){icon.textContent='🔢';title.textContent='Pattern Challenge';prompt.textContent='Find the missing number: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?';const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='mini-grid';[36,42,48].forEach(n=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='mini-choice';b.textContent=n;b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();n===48?rewardChallenge():toast('Not this one — think about the pattern!')};g.appendChild(b)});area.appendChild(g)}else if(type==='math'){icon.textContent='⚡';title.textContent='Quick Math';prompt.textContent='You have 12 seconds. What is 18 + 7 × 2?';const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='mini-grid';[50,32,40].forEach(n=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='mini-choice';b.textContent=n;b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();n===32?rewardChallenge():toast('Keep going!')};g.appendChild(b)});area.appendChild(g)}else if(type==='word'){icon.textContent='🔤';title.textContent='Word Order';prompt.textContent='Arrange the words to make a useful learning sentence.';let arr=['learn','by','doing'].sort(()=>Math.random()-.5),picked=[];const g=document.createElement('div');g.className='mini-grid';arr.forEach(w=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='mini-choice';b.textContent=w;b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();picked.push(w);b.disabled=true;b.classList.add('selected');if(picked.length===3){if(picked.join(' ')==='learn by doing')rewardChallenge();else{toast('Order reset — try again');picked=[];setTimeout(()=>[...g.children].forEach(x=>{x.disabled=false;x.classList.remove('selected')}),350)}}};g.appendChild(b)});area.appendChild(g)}else{icon.textContent='✍️';title.textContent='Sentence Builder Mission';prompt.innerHTML='Write one full English sentence describing your team, using the words <b>Visionaries</b>, <b>build</b> and <b>together</b>.';const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.className='prompt-box';ta.placeholder='Example: Visionaries build great things together...';const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='primary';b.textContent='Submit →';b.onclick=()=>{sfxClick();let v=ta.value.trim().toLowerCase(),points=(v.length>20?1:0)+(v.includes('visionaries')?1:0)+(v.includes('build')?1:0)+(v.includes('together')?1:0);if(points>=3)rewardChallenge(25,40);else toast('Try to include all three words in one sentence.')};area.append(ta,b)}}
function finish(){stopBgMusic();show('end');sfxLevelup();confettiBurst(70);let acc=Math.round(correct/10*100);$('endTitle').textContent='Quest Complete';$('endSummary').textContent=acc>=80?`Strong run, ${player}! Keep building your knowledge across categories.`:`Nice journey, ${player}! Review the explanations and keep practicing.`;$('fs').textContent=score;$('fx').textContent=xp;$('fl').textContent=levelFor(totalXp);$('fa').textContent=acc+'%';$('fc').textContent=correct;$('fb').textContent='x'+bestCombo;$('flives').textContent=lives;$('fquestions').textContent=10;let badge=score>=125?'👑 Knowledge Master':score>=90?'🏆 Quest Champion':score>=60?'🧠 Smart Explorer':'🌱 Rising Learner';$('badge').textContent=badge;$('categories').innerHTML=[...sessionCats].map(c=>`<span class="cat-chip">${c}</span>`).join('');history.unshift({date:new Date().toLocaleString(),score,xp,accuracy:acc,correct,bestCombo,categories:[...sessionCats]});save();updateHome()}
function finishGameOver(){stopBgMusic();show('gameover');sfxWrong();let acc=Math.round(correct/10*100);$('gos').textContent=score;$('gox').textContent=xp;$('goa').textContent=acc+'%';$('goc').textContent=correct;$('gameoverSummary').textContent=`${player}, the quest ended after all 3 lives were lost. You still learned from ${correct} correct answers.`;history.unshift({date:new Date().toLocaleString(),score,xp,accuracy:acc,correct,bestCombo,categories:[...sessionCats],gameOver:true});save();updateHome()}

let fruitTimer=null,fruitSpawn=null,fruitScore=0,fruitSeconds=30,fruitStreak=0,fruitRunning=false,fruitBombs=0;
const fruitTypes=[['🍎',10],['🍊',10],['🍉',15],['🍓',15],['🍇',20],['🍍',25],['🥝',20]];
function fruitStart(){clearInterval(fruitTimer);clearInterval(fruitSpawn);fruitScore=0;fruitSeconds=30;fruitStreak=0;fruitBombs=0;fruitRunning=true;$('fruitScore').textContent=0;$('fruitTime').textContent=30;$('fruitStreak').textContent=0;$('fruitBombs').textContent=0;$('fruitArena').innerHTML='';show('fruit');spawnFruit();fruitSpawn=setInterval(spawnFruit,650);fruitTimer=setInterval(()=>{fruitSeconds--;$('fruitTime').textContent=fruitSeconds;if(fruitSeconds<=0)fruitEnd()},1000)}
function spawnFruit(){if(!fruitRunning)return;const arena=$('fruitArena');if(arena.children.length>12)return;let bomb=Math.random()<.10;let [emoji,pts]=fruitTypes[Math.floor(Math.random()*fruitTypes.length)];if(bomb){emoji='💣';pts=-30}const el=document.createElement('button');el.className='fruit';el.textContent=emoji;el.setAttribute('aria-label',bomb?'Bomb':'Fruit');el.style.left=(7+Math.random()*86)+'%';el.style.top=(12+Math.random()*78)+'%';el.onclick=()=>{if(!fruitRunning)return;const val=bomb?pts:pts+Math.min(fruitStreak*2,20);fruitScore=Math.max(0,fruitScore+val);fruitStreak=bomb?0:fruitStreak+1;$('fruitScore').textContent=fruitScore;$('fruitStreak').textContent=fruitStreak;el.classList.add('pop');burst(el,bomb?'💥':'✨');setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),260);if(bomb){fruitBombs++;$('fruitBombs').textContent=fruitBombs;toast('💣 Bomb hit! '+fruitBombs+'/3');if(fruitBombs>=3){fruitRunning=false;setTimeout(()=>fruitOut(),280)}}};arena.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>{if(el.isConnected)el.remove()},1900)}
function burst(el,icon){for(let n=0;n<5;n++){const b=document.createElement('span');b.className='fruit-burst';b.textContent=icon;b.style.left=el.style.left;b.style.top=el.style.top;b.style.setProperty('--dx',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--dy',(Math.random()*120-60)+'px');$('fruitArena').appendChild(b);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),650)}}
function fruitEnd(){if(!fruitRunning)return;fruitRunning=false;clearInterval(fruitTimer);clearInterval(fruitSpawn);$('fruitArena').innerHTML=`<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center"><div><div style="font-size:65px">🏆</div><h2 style="font-family:'Space Grotesk'">Fruit Crash Complete!</h2><p style="color:var(--muted)">You scored <b>${fruitScore}</b> points with a streak of <b>${fruitStreak}</b>.</p><button class="primary" id="fruitAgain">🔄 Play Again</button></div></div>`;$('fruitAgain').onclick=fruitStart;toast('🍓 Fruit Crash score: '+fruitScore)}
function fruitOut(){clearInterval(fruitTimer);clearInterval(fruitSpawn);$('fruitArena').innerHTML=`<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center"><div><div style="font-size:65px">💥</div><h2 style="font-family:'Space Grotesk'">You're Out!</h2><p style="color:var(--muted)">3 bombs hit! Final score <b>${fruitScore}</b> with a best streak of <b>${fruitStreak}</b>.</p><button class="primary" id="fruitAgain">🔄 Play Again</button></div></div>`;$('fruitAgain').onclick=fruitStart;toast('💥 3 bombs hit — you\'re out! Score: '+fruitScore)}

function updateHome(){$('profileName').textContent=player;$('homeGreeting').textContent=`Ready, ${player}?`;$('homeHistory').textContent=history.length?`${history.length} quest${history.length===1?'':'s'} completed • ${played.length}/${QUESTIONS.length+SENTENCE_QUESTIONS.length} unique questions explored.`:'No quests completed yet.'}
function confettiBurst(count=30){const colors=['#8b5cf6','#3b82f6','#22d3ee','#34d399','#fbbf24','#fb7185'];for(let n=0;n<count;n++){const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='confetti-piece';p.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';p.style.background=colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)];p.style.animationDuration=(1.6+Math.random()*1.4)+'s';p.style.opacity=String(.7+Math.random()*.3);document.body.appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),3200)}}
let audioCtx=null,muted=localStorage.getItem('kqMuted')==='1',bgTimer=null,bgStep=0;
function ensureAudio(){if(!audioCtx){try{audioCtx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)()}catch(e){}}if(audioCtx&&audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume()}
function beep(freq,dur,type='sine',vol=.16,delay=0){if(muted)return;ensureAudio();if(!audioCtx)return;const t=audioCtx.currentTime+delay,o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol,t+.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+.03)}
function sfxClick(){beep(500,.07,'square',.1)}
function sfxCorrect(){beep(659,.12,'sine',.18);beep(880,.16,'sine',.15,.09)}
function sfxWrong(){beep(190,.28,'sawtooth',.16)}
function sfxLevelup(){[523,659,784,1046].forEach((f,n)=>beep(f,.18,'triangle',.15,n*.09))}
function sfxBoss(){[392,523,659,784,988].forEach((f,n)=>beep(f,.22,'triangle',.17,n*.1))}
function startBgMusic(){if(muted||bgTimer)return;ensureAudio();if(!audioCtx)return;const pattern=[392,0,523,0,659,0,523,0];bgStep=0;bgTimer=setInterval(()=>{const f=pattern[bgStep%pattern.length];if(f)beep(f,.5,'sine',.05);bgStep++},420)}
function stopBgMusic(){clearInterval(bgTimer);bgTimer=null}
function updateMuteBtn(){$('muteBtn').textContent=muted?'🔇':'🔊'}
function toggleMute(){muted=!muted;localStorage.setItem('kqMuted',muted?'1':'0');updateMuteBtn();if(muted)stopBgMusic();else if(!$('game').classList.contains('hidden'))startBgMusic()}
function renderHistory(){const box=$('historyList');box.innerHTML=history.length?history.slice(0,20).map((h,n)=>`<div class="history-row"><strong>#${n+1}</strong><div><b>${h.gameOver?'Game Over':'Quest Complete'}</b><br><small>${h.date} • ${h.correct} correct • ${h.bestCombo} best combo</small></div><strong>${h.accuracy}%</strong></div>`).join(''):'<div class="history-row"><span>—</span><div>No quest history yet.</div><span>—</span></div>'}
function openProfile(){$('nameInput').value=player==='Player'?'':player;$('profileModal').classList.remove('hidden');setTimeout(()=>$('nameInput').focus(),50)}
$('fruitHome').onclick=fruitStart;$('fruitStart').onclick=fruitStart;$('fruitBack').onclick=()=>{fruitRunning=false;clearInterval(fruitTimer);clearInterval(fruitSpawn);show('home')};$('start').onclick=start;$('again').onclick=start;$('restartGame').onclick=start;$('homeEnd').onclick=()=>show('home');$('homeOver').onclick=()=>show('home');$('brandHome').onclick=()=>show('home');$('muteBtn').onclick=toggleMute;$('profileBtn').onclick=openProfile;$('profileHome').onclick=openProfile;$('closeProfile').onclick=()=>$('profileModal').classList.add('hidden');$('saveProfile').onclick=()=>{player=$('nameInput').value.trim()||'Player';save();$('profileModal').classList.add('hidden');updateHome();toast(`Welcome, ${player}!`)};$('historyBtn').onclick=()=>{renderHistory();show('history')};$('historyBack').onclick=()=>show('home');updateHome();stats();updateMuteBtn();
function resetToHome(){clearInterval(timerId);clearInterval(fruitTimer);clearInterval(fruitSpawn);stopBgMusic();fruitRunning=false;answered=false;round=[];i=0;score=0;xp=0;correct=0;lives=3;combo=0;bestCombo=0;streak=0;challengeRewarded=false;sessionCats=new Set();updateHome();stats();show('home')}
window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(e){if(e.persisted)location.reload();else resetToHome()});

</script>
</body></html>
